title: Stock Market Highlights, Sept 16: Sensex gains 333 points, Nifty rises 99 points; FMCG, PSU banks outperform - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
Sensex, Nifty 50 | Stock Market Highlights - Indian equity markets closed higher on Wednesday, tracking gains across regional markets as investor sentiment remained supported by expectations surrounding the US Federal Reserve’s interest rate decision. The Nifty 50 gained 99 points, or 0.43 per cent, to close at 23,217.60, while the BSE Sensex rose 332.63 points, or 0.45 per cent, to 74,336.45.

Large-cap stocks led the domestic gains, with buying interest concentrated in banking, FMCG and automobile counters. Nifty FMCG rose 1.82 per cent, Nifty PSU Bank gained 1.27 per cent and Nifty Private Bank advanced 0.73 per cent. Metal, auto and media stocks also gained. Nifty IT declined 1.79 per cent following recent outperformance, while pharma slipped 0.13 per cent.

SBI Life, HDFC Life, ITC and Trent were among the top Nifty gainers. TCS, Wipro, Infosys and Tech Mahindra were major laggards. Brent crude traded at $108 a barrel.

Half of all IPO investors on HDFC SKY are below the age of 35, compared with just over a quarter on InvestRight, according to the report.

BSE Sensex settled 332.63 pts or 0.45% higher at 74,336.45. Nifty 50 was up 99 pts or 0.43% to 23,217.60. FMCG and PSU Banks outperformed on the sectoral front. IT dragged the most.

Hero Motors IPO was subscribed 1.18 times by 3.21 pm on the first day of bidding on Wednesday, with retail investors leading the subscription.

The retail portion was subscribed 1.96 times, while the non-institutional investors (NIIs) portion was subscribed 0.94 times. The qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) portion was subscribed 0.01 times.
